source_text_lines.text: MAKE UP AIR FAN (400°C 2Hrs FIRE RATED)
- THERE WILL BE CO SENSOR CONSIDERED TO BASEMENT AND IT WILL BE
DISTRIBUTED ACCORDING TO THE AREA OF CLASSIFICATION.
- ALL CO SENSORS CONNECTED TO THE VENTILATION FAN THROUGH THE CO
- IF THE CO CONTENT IS LESS THAN 15 PPM, FAN WILL NOT WORK
- IF THE CO CONTENT IS 15-35 PPM , FAN WILL WORK ON 3ACH AS LOW SPEED.
- IF THE CO CONTENT IS MORE THAN 35PPM, FAN WILL WORK ON NORMAL SPEED
- IF THE CO CONENT IS MORE THAN 100PPM, OR FIRE ALAM GOES OFF, FAN WILL
WORK ON HIGH SPEED AS 10 ACH
- MAKE UP AIR WILL BE 85 % OF EXHAUST AIR IN ALL CASES AS PER UAE FIRE
- FRESH AND EXHAUST FANS ARE 400°C RATED FOR 2 HOURS
SMOKE PURGE SYSTEM SHOULD BE AUTOMATICALLY ACTIVATED FOR
PARTICULAR FLOOR BY THE SMOKE DETECTION SYSTEM INCLUDING SUPPLY FAN
· PRESSURIZATION FOR OTHER FLOOR, LIFT AND STAIR SHOULD BE ACTIVATED IN
ORDER TO AVOID THE ENTRY OF SMOKE TO OTHER FLOOR OR IN STAIRCASE.
·ALL AIR CONDITION EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE SHUT DOWN IN CASE OF FIRE AND
ALL AIR SUPPLY TERMINAL NEED TO BE PROTECTED WITH FIRE/SMOKE DAMPERS
IN ORDER AVOID THE AIR CIRCULATION IN OTHER FLOOR.
693 L/S (10 ACH IN CASE OF FIRE)
